headword: {安全保障|あんぜんほしょう}

definitions.explanation: Measures taken to protect a nation from external threats, including military defense and diplomatic efforts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{安全保障|あんぜんほしょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

{安全保障|あんぜんほしょう}⟦{理事会|りじかい}→理事会：18635_rijikai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{緊急|きんきゅう}→緊急：11327_kinkyuu⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。

notes:
A compound of ⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧ (safety) + ⟦{保障|ほしょう}→保障：03719_hoshou⟧ (guarantee). Refers to measures taken to protect a nation from external threats, encompassing military, diplomatic, and economic dimensions. Formal and used mainly in political, academic, and news contexts.
